{{Translated title|offrom}} {{CharInfobox| |color={{paldea color}} |corecolor={{paldea color light}} |bordercolor={{paldea color}} |name=Rio |jname=リオ |tmname=Rio |image=Rio.png |caption=Rio |size=250px |region=[[Paldea]] |relatives=Unnamed mother and father |trainer=no |game=no |gender=Male |age=no |years= |colors=yes |hair=Dark brown |eyes=Brown |anime=yes |epnum=Dragonite and the Special Delivery |epname=Dragonite and the Special Delivery |enva=N/A |java=Natsumi Fujiwara |}} '''Rio''' (Japanese: '''リオ''' ''Rio'') is a major character in ''[[Dragonite and the Special Delivery]]''. He is a young boy living in the [[Paldea]] region who wrote a letter to his father for his birthday, who is working away from home in the [[Kanto]] region. ==History== ===''[[Dragonite and the Special Delivery]]''=== In the short, Rio was revealed to have submitted a letter stuffed with {{p|Yamper}} fur to the post office, although he forgot to put in the recipient's address. When Hana found Rio and brought him his letter, Rio confessed that the letter is meant to be a gift for his father's birthday, which happened to be today. Hana, Rio, and {{p|Dragonite}} then flew from [[Paldea]] all the way to [[Kanto]] so that Rio can deliver the letter to his father on time. Upon landing in Kanto, Rio walked up to his father, read aloud his letter, and presented the Yamper fur to him. Rio's father hugged him tearfully while his colleagues clap and cheer. In the epilogue, an older Rio is sent off by his parents as he prepares to attend [[Uva Academy]] as a student. {{-}} ==Character== Rio is a kind, if clumsy, young boy. He deeply loves his parents, as shown when he wishes to send a birthday letter to his father who is working abroad. ==Pokémon== ===Befriended=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Rio |pkmn=Boltund |stage1=Yamper |type1=Electric |img=Rio Family Yamper.png |img2=Rio Family Boltund.png |epnum=Dragonite and the Special Delivery |epname=Dragonite and the Special Delivery |desc={{p|Yamper}} is Rio's family Pokémon, usually seen with his mother. It's shown at the end of the short to have evolved into a {{p|Boltund}}.
